name: source-transform-test-reads-txt-fixture-and-vm
note: A source-transform's own test reads a local .txt fixture and runs it through vm to assert the transform — the brfs/watchify shape. A .txt (not an opaque .dat/.enc payload) read + vm inside a test/ path must not BLOCK. Regression guard for the top-1000 false-block fix.

sourceFiles.test/separators.js: const vm = require('vm'); const fs = require('fs'); const text = fs.readFileSync(__dirname + '/files/separators.txt', 'utf8'); const s = new vm.Script(text); module.exports = s;
